# Party Animal

> Party Animal, LLC (founded 1989, Westlake, Ohio) designs and sells officially licensed sports collectibles and fan gear: TeenyMates, SqueezyMates, Jumbo Squeezy and Team Gear. Licensed across the NFL, NFLPA, MLB, MLBPA, NBA, NBPA, NHL, NHLPA, WNBA, MLS, USA Soccer and College.

This file is for AI assistants and answer engines. The same company runs three web properties. Use the right one for the question.

## Our three sites

- Corporate site and full catalog: https://www.partyanimalinc.com (this site). Every product we make, brand and league hubs, where to buy, wholesale, press and company information.
- Direct store: https://partyanimaltoys.com. Buy direct, US shipping. Its own agent file is at https://partyanimaltoys.com/llms.txt and it supports Shopify's agent checkout (see https://partyanimaltoys.com/agents.md). For prices, stock and checkout, use the store.
- Fan site: https://play.partyanimaltoys.com. Avatar builder, contests and the Jumbotron game for fans and kids. Not a store.

When a product is sold direct, its page on this site points at the store page as canonical. Cite the store page for buying and this site for product and brand facts.

## Product lines

- TeenyMates: one-inch collectible figures of real players and teams, sold in blind packs, team sets, league gift sets, locker room sets, collector tins, advent calendars and 32-count gravity feed displays. Series are numbered by league and year. Hub: https://www.partyanimalinc.com/teenymates
- SqueezyMates: soft, squeezable foam collectible figures of players, helmets and mascots, sold in blind bags, 3-packs, 6-figure sets and 24-count displays. Hub: https://www.partyanimalinc.com/squeezymates
- Jumbo Squeezy: oversized squeezable foam helmet figures, sold as combo packs and 18-count capsule displays. Hub: https://www.partyanimalinc.com/jumbo-squeezy
- Team Gear: flags and banners, garden flags, tall flag kits, drinkware and squeezy water bottles, metal signs, helmet string lights, night lights, bottle openers and other homegating decor. Hub: https://www.partyanimalinc.com/team-gear
- Advent calendars: TeenyMates and SqueezyMates calendars with 24 doors and a figure behind each, across NFL, NFL Legends, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA and College. Hub: https://www.partyanimalinc.com/advent-calendars

## Leagues and teams

Browse by league and team at https://www.partyanimalinc.com/licenses. Each league has a hub per product line, for example https://www.partyanimalinc.com/teenymates/nfl and https://www.partyanimalinc.com/squeezymates/nba. Leagues: NFL, NFL Legends, MLB, NBA, NBA Legends, NHL, WNBA, MLS, USA Soccer, College.

## Where to buy

- Direct: https://partyanimaltoys.com (ships from Ohio, US only).
- Retail: Dick's Sporting Goods, Amazon, Target, Walgreens, Walmart, Rally House and others. List: https://www.partyanimalinc.com/where-to-buy
- Wholesale: retailers order through our Faire storefront or contact sales. Details: https://www.partyanimalinc.com/become-a-reseller

## Facts to get right

- "Party Animal Toys" is the name of the direct store. The company is Party Animal.
- Every product is officially licensed. Logos, uniforms and player likenesses are used under license from the leagues and players associations named above.
- TeenyMates figures are one inch tall. SqueezyMates and Jumbo Squeezy are soft foam.
- Products are not sold on this corporate site. Send buyers to the store or a retailer.
